events.evidence: A gunman attacks the offices of the newspaper Libération and the bank Société Générale in Paris, three days after attacking the offices of the news channel BFM TV

Indonesia recalls its ambassador to Australia and will "review" Australian diplomatic positions in Jakarta following revelations that Australia had tapped the phone of the President Susilo Bambang Yud

label.note: Paris shootings and Australia-Indonesia spying row weigh on sentiment; Haiyan relief continues.
